messages.subject: Project Zephyr — FTO and patent-validity instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Alan,

We're acting for Penrose Robotics on the out-licence of the Helmsman platform. Could you provide a freedom-to-operate and validity view on the Helmsman patent family — GB2598447, EP3892511, GB2611203 (granted) and the two pending applications? The licensee (a major UK retailer) will want comfort before signature, target late November. Aisha can give you the technical materials.

Thanks,
James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Corporate & Technology
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0519

This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Happy to. We'll run the searches and review the prosecution histories. On a first look the decentralised traffic-management claims (GB2598447, GB2611203) look robust; the charging-slot patent (EP3892511) has a dependent-claim point I'll flag. I'll aim to have the written opinion to you by early November.

Alan Foster
Hartington IP
